svg.text: NAMING TRAP, load-bearing: the field names are inverted. `rangeFFT` IS FFT-1 and performs the AZIMUTH transform;
`azFFT` IS FFT-2 and performs the RANGE transform. Every table in this deck uses the physical meaning, not the field name.
Dashed = no kernel of its own. Window is fused into the FFT-1 feeder and detect into the FFT-2 unloader,
so two of the six stages cost zero time and zero DDR passes.
